about: The rows of atlas/data/admin1.bin (docs/atlas-v2-admin1-layer.md §3.1): one per country, its units with their ISO 3166-2 codes, DECLARED English names and kinds, and Wikidata items. Read by build-admin1.js and check-admin1.js; a country is a row here and a rebuild of that one file.
rules: iso: the current ISO 3166-2 code, as Wikidata states it with preferred rank (property P300, queried 2026-10-30). ISO changed four Indian codes on 2023-11-23 (IN-CT to IN-CG, IN-OR to IN-OD, IN-TG to IN-TS, IN-UT to IN-UK); Natural Earth 5.1.1 (2022) still carries the old ones, named here as `ne`. The entity id is adm1:<a3>:<iso in lower case>.

name and kind are declared here, never read from Natural Earth: its type_en calls Himachal Pradesh a union territory and leaves Gujarat blank (recorded as `neType`). India has 28 states and 8 union territories.

corrections: a source fault is corrected only here, dated and with its reason, and the build verifies each one (a `drop` names the ring by a point inside it and refuses the correction when its `check` point falls inside the ring; an `island` gives the core's island ring around its point to one unit whole and drops the lines on it; a `join` names the two line ends by Natural Earth's own coordinates and fails when either is gone). A join's chord is Folio's approximation and the reason says so.
qid: the Wikidata item that carries the unit's ISO 3166-2 code. For Delhi and Chandigarh that is the territory, not the city Natural Earth names (`neQid`).

corrections.reason: Natural Earth's ring for Mahé, Puducherry's enclave on the Kerala coast, is misplaced: its box is 75.222–75.397°E, 11.967–12.148°N, the ring at its nearest some 41 km north-north-west of Mahé, and it covers about 125 km², where the territory is about 9 km². Dropped, so the ground is Kerala's, as its neighbouring lines say; Puducherry keeps its other three pieces. Mahé is not drawn until a sourced outline replaces this ring.

check.what: Mahé district, Wikidata Q639279 P625 (75.533°E, 11.700°N), queried 2026-10-30: the build refuses this correction if the ring ever contains it

corrections.reason: Diu Island: Natural Earth's ring for Diu is a coarse polygon (11 vertices, about 5 km²), and its Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu–Gujarat line runs across the island, so most of the island's ground in the core's OpenStreetMap coast (about 33 km²) fell to Gujarat. The whole island is Diu's: the core's island ring that contains the point is given to the territory whole and the Natural Earth line pieces on it are dropped; the mainland part (Ghoghla) keeps Natural Earth's line.

check.what: Diu Island, Wikidata Q5283744: P625 (70.98°E, 20.71°N), P131 Diu district, P2046 38.8 km², queried 2026-10-30; the build refuses the correction when the point is in no island ring of the core's face, or in the mainland's

corrections.reason: Pulicat Lake: Natural Earth leaves the lagoon out of both states, so its Andhra Pradesh–Tamil Nadu line stops at the west shore (80.260°E, 13.469°N) and starts again at the east shore (80.278°E, 13.513°N); the core's OpenStreetMap land counts the lagoon as land. The two ends are joined by a straight chord of about 5 km across the lagoon: Folio's approximation of where the line runs in the lake, not a sourced line.

units.name: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
